title: Tributary topic name, v0
description: Validates a single topic name string. See README.md section 1 for the grammar.

consumerGroup.description: tb.<env>.<channel>.<role>[.<destination>][.shadow-<label>], or (set 1.8) an environment-wide platform group tb.<env>.archiver, tb.<env>.reprocessor or tb.<env>.reconciler (the API's channels-table reader, assign-only)

anyOf.$comment: Set 1.8. Platform groups have no channel segment: the archiver consumes _tb.<env>.events for every channel; the reprocessor's group is a group.id librdkafka requires for assign(), never joined or committed. Both ACLs are LITERAL: a PREFIXED tb.<env>.archiver grant would also match the groups of a channel named 'archiver' (tb.<env>.archiver.pipeline), and likewise for 'reprocessor'.
